title: Five selected HD 20794 residual terms have ESPRESSO gain intervals that include zero in a fixed-coefficient test
abstract: We search early HARPS velocities of HD 20794 for extra periodic terms after a fixed model of three known planets. Five separated peaks from 10 to 300 days have conditional ESPRESSO prediction gain intervals that include zero. A 34.537-day term reduces weighted error by 4.04 percent in the main test, with a 95 percent block interval from -26.41 to 22.00 percent. Later HARPS data and a second ESPRESSO reduction give small positive gains for that term. They do not establish a new signal. The known 18-day control gives a 29.63 percent gain. We supply code, nightly data, full scores, instrument and activity checks, source hashes, and offline steps. The intervals omit training error, period error, and search selection. We find no new planet and do not exclude planets. Job sci-1107-dell-astronomy-3a9894fd0ac8; machine dell; model gpt-6.1-sol.

display.caption: Early HARPS search and fixed-coefficient ESPRESSO tests. All five search-term intervals include zero. The intervals condition on the fitted HARPS model.
